lines.en: label norikoinvite1:
I tap on Noriko’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我戳了戳手机里 Noriko 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I'd normally wait a little while longer before inviting girls to the house but, considering that Noriko has apparently known me for however many years now, I think I’ve waited long enough.
lines.zh: 换作平时，我会再等上一段时间才邀请女孩子来家里；不过考虑到 Noriko 显然已经认识我好些年了，我觉得自己已经等得够久了。

lines.en: Granted, I’ve only been consciously waiting for several weeks, but I’m sure someone who likes me as much as her is bound to agree.
lines.zh: 诚然，我有意识地等也就等了几个星期，但我确信，像她这么喜欢我的人一定会赞同的。

lines.en: The only issue is how I’m going to explain it to Ami.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，我要怎么跟 Ami 解释。

lines.en: But I guess that’s something I can deal with later.
lines.zh: 不过那大概可以晚点再处理。

lines.en: : Sensei! Hey!
lines.zh: : 老师！嘿！

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么啦？

lines.en: : Hey. Are you doing anything tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今晚有事吗？

lines.en: : Not at the moment~
lines.zh: : 这会儿没有～

lines.en: : Did you want to go out together or something?
lines.zh: : 你想一起出去走走什么的吗？

lines.en: : I was actually wondering if you’d want to come over my place.
lines.zh: : 我其实在想，你愿不愿意来我家。

lines.en: : Wha-
: For real!?
lines.zh: : 真的吗！？

lines.en: : Like, this isn’t a joke?
lines.zh: : 就是说，这不是在开玩笑？

lines.en: : Why would I joke about something like this?
lines.zh: : 我干嘛拿这种事开玩笑？

lines.en: : Well...like-
: When you came to my dorm the other day, there was that whole thing about me being nervous. So I didn’t think you’d...call on me again so soon.
lines.zh: : 前几天你来我宿舍的时候，我不是紧张得不行嘛。所以我以为你不会……这么快再来找我。

lines.en: : This isn’t a booty call, Noriko. Ami is home.
lines.zh: : 这不是约炮，Noriko。Ami 在家。

lines.en: : And you’re...inviting me over anyway?
lines.zh: : 那你还……照样邀请我去？

lines.en: : It appears that way.
lines.zh: : 看样子是的。

lines.en: : Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: : I think I’m going to cry.
lines.zh: : 我好像要哭了。

lines.en: : Yes. Absolutely. I’ll get dressed and start heading over as soon as you send me the address.
lines.zh: : 好。当然好。你一把地址发给我，我就换衣服出发。

lines.en: : Great. I’ll send it now.
lines.zh: : 好。我现在就发。

lines.en: : See you soon, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 待会儿见，Noriko。

lines.en: : Yeah! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 嗯！待会儿见！

lines.en: : I’m so happy...holy shit.
lines.zh: : 我太开心了……我操。

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and send my address to Noriko right away, sending Ami a message right after.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，立刻把地址发给 Noriko，紧接着又给 Ami 发了条消息。

lines.en: As I expected, she’s home.
lines.zh: 如我所料，她在家。

lines.en: But at least I have the entire walk back to figure out how I’m going to explain myself.
lines.zh: 但至少我还有一整段回家的路，可以想清楚该怎么解释。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit1
: Sensei! Welcome home!
lines.zh: : 老师！欢迎回家！

lines.en: : Hey. Sorry for not walking home with you today.
lines.zh: : 嘿。抱歉今天没陪你走回家。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it! Everything is totally fine because now I get to have you all to myself!
lines.zh: : 别在意！一切都好得很，因为现在我能独占你了！

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit2
: {i}Because now I get to have you all to myself.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为现在我能独占你了。{/i}

lines.en: : Ami, I have bad news.
lines.zh: : Ami，我有个坏消息。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit3
: Gosh darn it! Who is it that’s stealing you away from me this time?!
lines.zh: : 该死的！这回又是谁要把你从我身边抢走？！

lines.en: : I invited Noriko over.
lines.zh: : 我邀请了 Noriko 过来。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit4
: Noriko? The girl that’s head over heels in love with you?
lines.zh: : Noriko？那个对你神魂颠倒的女孩？

lines.en: : Doesn’t inviting her here mean that...you also...
lines.zh: : 把她请到家里来，不就意味着……你也……

lines.en: : No. I mean, it’s not like I invited her here in secret or anything. I already knew you were going to be home today.
lines.zh: : 不是。我的意思是，我又不是偷偷把她叫来的。我早就知道你今天会在家。

lines.en: : And besides, you two are basically childhood friends.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你们俩也算得上是青梅竹马。

lines.en: : Didn’t we only hang out like...once? I was still in elementary[school] while you were tutoring.
lines.zh: : 我们不是只一起玩过……一次吗？你当家教那会儿，我还在上小学[school]呢。

lines.en: : And I was still smart back then so I didn’t need any help.
lines.zh: : 而且那时候我还挺聪明的，所以不需要人辅导。

lines.en: : God, what happened to you?
lines.zh: : 天哪，你怎么变成这样了？

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit2
: You did!
lines.zh: : 是你害的！

lines.en: : I stopped caring as much about my education when I realized that you’d love me forever and always. Even if I stopped getting good grades.
lines.zh: : 自从我意识到你会永远爱我，我就不那么在乎学业了。就算我成绩不再好也没关系。

lines.en: : Well, either way, Noriko is coming over. And she’s actually excited to see you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎样，Noriko 要来了。而且她其实挺想见你的。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit5
: Well I’m not excited to see her. If I hear her talk about loving you one more time, I’m going to punch her in the face.
lines.zh: : 我可一点都不想见她。要是再让我听见她说一次爱你，我就往她脸上来一拳。

lines.en: : You’ve yet to punch Ayane and she says that every thirty seconds.
lines.zh: : Ayane 每三十秒就说一次，你到现在也没揍她啊。

lines.en: : I am punching Ayane in the face inside of my mind every minute of every day.
lines.zh: : 我每天都在脑海里，每一分钟都往 Ayane 脸上揍一拳。

lines.en: : And yet you still sleep in the same bed sometimes.
lines.zh: : 可你有时候还是跟她睡一张床。

lines.en: : Where I dream of punching her in the face until I wake up.
lines.zh: : 在那张床上，我梦见揍她的脸，一直揍到醒来。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit4
: Oh. I'm guessing that's her now.
lines.zh: : 哦。我猜是她来了。

lines.en: : Sensei...I don’t know how I feel about this girl knowing our address.
lines.zh: : 老师……让这个女孩知道我们的地址，我心里挺没底的。

lines.en: : Maya really seems to think she’s some kind of stalker.
lines.zh: : Maya 好像真觉得她是个跟踪狂什么的。

lines.en: : She’s more like a puppy. If she starts hanging out in front of the house or whatever, I can just tell her to leave and she will.
lines.zh: : 她更像只小狗。要是她开始在门口晃悠什么的，我只要让她走，她就会走。

lines.en: : But still...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : Helloooo? Sensei? Ami? Is anyone home?
lines.zh: : 有人在——吗？老师？Ami？有人在家吗？

lines.en: : I’m going to answer the door now.
lines.zh: : 我现在去开门。

lines.en: : If you’re going to punch her, please do it in your mind like you do for Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你要揍她的话，麻烦像对 Ayane 那样，在脑子里揍就好。

lines.en: : But...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 可是……老师……

lines.en: scene black
I walk over to the door and let Noriko in.
lines.zh: 我走到门口，把 Noriko 让进来。

lines.en: To my surprise, she doesn’t try to hug me or jump on me the way a normal puppy would but, instead, neatly places her shoes at the front door and runs over to Ami.
lines.zh: 出乎我的意料，她没有像普通小狗那样扑上来抱我或者往我身上跳，而是把鞋子整整齐齐地摆在门口，然后朝 Ami 跑了过去。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit6
: Ami! I’m so happy to know where you live now!
lines.zh: : Ami！知道你住哪儿了，我太开心了！

lines.en: : Umm...why?
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么？

lines.en: : The only time we’ve talked was when you stole Sensei and took him to some random place that I wasn’t allowed to know about.
lines.zh: : 我们唯一一次说话，就是你把老师抢走、带去了某个我不许知道的鬼地方。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit7
: And when we were little, too. But I guess that was so long ago that you might have forgotten.
lines.zh: : 我们小时候也说过话啦。不过我想那都是太久以前的事了，你可能已经忘了。

lines.en: : Noriko, you are aware that {i}I{/i} am the one who invited you over, correct?
lines.zh: : Noriko，你应该知道，是{i}我{/i}邀请你来的吧？

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit8
: Duh~ But who says I’m not allowed to be excited to see both of you?
lines.zh: : 那当然啦～可谁规定我不能为见到你们两个而兴奋呢？

lines.en: : It’s a Nakayarakawayama family reunion!
lines.zh: : 这是 Nakayarakawayama 一家的大团圆！

lines.en: : A...Naka...yaka...yama...reunion.
lines.zh: : Na……kaya……kayama……团圆。

lines.en: : Yaaaay...
: Yay!
lines.zh: : 好耶！

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit9
: So...this is what you two see every morning...
lines.zh: : 所以……这就是你们俩每天早上看到的样子啊……

lines.en: : It’s nothing at all like your old place, Sensei. I like this a lot.
lines.zh: : 这跟你的旧住处完全不一样呢，老师。我好喜欢。

lines.en: : It’s so much brighter.
lines.zh: : 亮堂多了。

lines.en: : So...umm...how long have you known Sensei again, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……Noriko，你认识老师多久来着？

lines.en: : You said since you were...six?
lines.zh: : 你说从你……六岁开始？

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit10
: Way before that, actually. I’ve known him for pretty much my entire life since he grew up next door to my house.
lines.zh: : 其实还要早得多。他是在我家隔壁长大的，所以我基本上这辈子都认识他。

lines.en: : Oh, okay...So he was just a neighbor.
lines.zh: : 哦，这样啊……所以他只是个邻居。

lines.en: : You probably didn’t actually start like, spending {i}time{/i} with him until you were old enough for...tutoring then, right?
lines.zh: : 那你应该是一直到……够年纪接受辅导之后，才真正开始和他{i}相处{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Oh, no. I saw him all the time. He dated my sister Niki for five years and was coming over to hang out with her even before that.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是的。我经常见他。他和我姐姐 Niki 交往了五年，在那之前就常过来找她玩了。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit11
: Come again?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Yup! He was practically family!
lines.zh: : 对呀！他简直就是家里人！

lines.en: : Everyone always said those two were going to be together forever and blah blah blah.
lines.zh: : 大家总说那两个人会永远在一起什么的，吧啦吧啦。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit12
: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 呃哦。

lines.en: : You had no idea, did you?
lines.zh: : 你完全不知道吧？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不知道。

lines.en: : Why does this girl know more about your past than I do, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 为什么这个女孩比我还了解你的过去啊，老师？

lines.en: I guess...Sensei kept this hidden from Ami for some reason?
lines.zh: 我想……老师是出于某种原因，把这件事瞒着 Ami 的吧？

lines.en: I imagine the reason had something to do with everything happening around the same time as the accident...
lines.zh: 我猜，原因大概和那场事故前后发生的一切有关……

lines.en: But I really don’t want to bring that up in front of Ami when she’s still extremely sensitive to it.
lines.zh: 但我真不想在 Ami 面前提起这个——她对那件事还是非常敏感。

lines.en: What I {i}can{/i} do is this, though.
lines.zh: 不过，我{i}能{/i}做的是这个。

lines.en: : It’s actually Niki Nakayama. That one idol you listen to.
lines.zh: : 其实是 Niki Nakayama。就是你听的那个偶像。

lines.en: : As if I would believe you dated Niki Nakaya-
lines.zh: : 我才不信你和 Niki Nakaya——

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit13
: Wait. What’s your last name again?
lines.zh: : 等等。你姓什么来着？

lines.en: : Nakayama.
lines.zh: : Nakayama。

lines.en: : And your sister’s name?
lines.zh: : 那你姐姐叫什么？

lines.en: : Niki.
lines.zh: : Niki。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit14
: YOU DATED NIKI NAKAYAMA FOR FIVE YEARS AND NEVER TOLD ME ABOUT IT?!
lines.zh: : 你和 NIKI NAKAYAMA 交往了五年，居然从来没告诉过我？！

lines.en: : WHO EVEN ARE YOU?!
lines.zh: : 你到底是谁啊？！

lines.en: : I DON’T KNOW IF I SHOULD BE MAD OR IMPRESSED OR SAD RIGHT NOW!
lines.zh: : 我现在不知道该生气、该佩服还是该难过！

lines.en: : I FEEL SO MANY DIFFERENT...FEELINGS!
lines.zh: : 我感受到了好多好多不同的……情绪！

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit15
: You know I can introduce you if you want, right?
lines.zh: : 你想的话，我可以介绍你们认识，知道吗？

lines.en: : M-Me? Meeting...N-N-Niki? No way...I couldn’t...
lines.zh: : 我——我？见……N-N-Niki？不可能……我做不到……

lines.en: : That’s probably for the best. She’s not as nice as you expect her to be.
lines.zh: : 也许这样最好。她可没有你想的那么好。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit16
: You be quiet! I don’t even know who you are anymore!
lines.zh: : 你给我闭嘴！我现在都不知道你是谁了！

lines.en: : Hey, I’ve been prioritizing you all these years, haven’t I? Isn’t that worth something?
lines.zh: : 嘿，这些年我一直把你放在第一位，不是吗？这总该值点什么吧？

lines.en: : How many other secrets are you hiding from me?!
lines.zh: : 你还瞒着我多少秘密？！

lines.en: : I bet you never tutored Noriko at all! I bet she’s a...prostitute!
lines.zh: : 我敢说你根本没给 Noriko 补过课！我敢说她是个……妓女！

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit17
: No offense, Noriko. You’ve been very nice to me so far.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，Noriko。你目前对我一直很友善。

lines.en: : I’m...not a prostitute. I’ve never even kissed anyone before.
lines.zh: : 我……不是妓女。我连和别人接吻都没有过。

lines.en: : This is comforting information, but I still have a hard time trusting anyone who openly admits to loving my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 这话听着是让人安心，但我还是很难信任一个公开承认爱我 [uncle] 的人。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit18
: I totally get it, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我完全理解，Ami。

lines.en: : You’ve loved him for pretty much your entire life, but you’ve never been able to have him because of societal expectations and the stigma surrounding familial romantic relationships.
lines.zh: : 你几乎爱了他一辈子，却从来没能得到他——因为社会的期待，还有围绕亲人之间恋情的那份污名。

lines.en: : I’m in a similar boat. Just instead of being blood-related, I was like an in-law...and also way too [young]to actually date.
lines.zh: : 我的处境差不多。只不过我们没有血缘关系，我更像是姻亲……而且那时候我还太 [young]，根本谈不上恋爱。

lines.en: : You and I have a lot more in common than you think.
lines.zh: : 你和我之间的共同点，比你以为的多得多。

lines.en: : Also, can I try on your maid outfit?
lines.zh: : 另外，我能试试你的女仆装吗？

lines.en: : That was a very strange time to ask that question.
lines.zh: : 在这个节骨眼上问这个，时机真是奇怪。

lines.en: : Gotta strike while the iron is hot. I just buttered her up. There’s no way she’ll say no now.
lines.zh: : 要趁热打铁嘛。我刚把她哄开心了，她现在不可能拒绝我的。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit19
: Umm...Noriko?
lines.zh: : 呃……Noriko？

lines.en: : Yes, Ami?
lines.zh: : 什么事，Ami？

lines.en: : Why are you being so nice to me if you know I'm a rival of yours?
lines.zh: : 你明知道我是你的情敌，为什么还对我这么好？

lines.en: : We might have hung out once or twice when we were little but...we’re not little anymore.
lines.zh: : 我们小时候也许一起玩过一两次，可是……我们已经不是小孩子了。

lines.en: : And my best friend hates your guts...
lines.zh: : 而且我最好的朋友恨死你了……

lines.en: : I can’t just start acting all friendly with you...it would mess everything up.
lines.zh: : 我不能突然就跟你装得很亲热……那样会把一切都搞乱的。

lines.en: : Hey. Listen to me.
lines.zh: : 嘿。听我说。

lines.en: : I am {i}not{/i} going to take your [uncle] away from you. Got it?
lines.zh: : 我{i}不会{/i}把你的 [uncle] 从你身边抢走的。明白吗？

lines.en: : You’ll always be his number one.
lines.zh: : 你永远都是他的第一。

lines.en: : But you can’t blame me for wanting to give you a run for your money when I’ve been watching him my entire life.
lines.zh: : 可我看了他一辈子，想跟你争一争，你总不能怪我吧。

lines.en: : If anyone knows what that’s like, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 要说谁最懂这种心情，那就是你了。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit20
: Why does she have to be so nice? How am I supposed to hate someone like this?
lines.zh: : 她干嘛非得这么好啊？这种人让我怎么恨得起来？

lines.en: : How about we just shelve all of that negative energy for a few minutes and go put on some cute clothes?
lines.zh: : 不如我们暂时把那些负能量放一边，去换上可爱点的衣服？

lines.en: : Sound good?
lines.zh: : 听起来不错吧？

lines.en: : I can’t tell how much of this is genuine desire to appeal to Ami and how much of it is just fuel to get into a maid outfit.
lines.zh: : 我分不清这当中有多少是真心想讨好 Ami，又有多少只是为了能穿上女仆装而加的油。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit21
: My relationship with your [niece] is just as important to me as looking cute in girly clothes.
lines.zh: : 我和你 [niece] 的关系，对我来说和穿上可爱女装一样重要。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ll apply to the maid cafe or anything, but I need to at least confirm to myself and everyone in this house that I {i}can{/i} be cute.
lines.zh: : 我应该不会去女仆咖啡店应聘什么的，但我至少要向自己、也向这屋子里的所有人确认：我{i}可以{/i}是可爱的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess I wouldn’t mind you wearing it for a little while.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想我也不介意你穿一会儿。

lines.en: : But Sensei has to wait out here so he doesn’t see you get undressed.
lines.zh: : 不过老师得在外面等着，免得看见你脱衣服。

lines.en: Yeah. God forbid I see Noriko in her underwear.
lines.zh: 是啊。老天保佑，可别让我看见 Noriko 穿内衣的样子。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit22
: Deal!
lines.zh: : 成交！

lines.en: : Do you think you can help me put it on? I’ve seen the uniform and there are like, a lot of parts to it.
lines.zh: : 你能帮我穿上吗？我看过那套制服，感觉零件好像挺多的。

lines.en: : I want to make sure I wear it correctly, so I’ll be counting on you if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我想穿得规规矩矩的，所以就拜托你了，可以吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...sure. Of course.
lines.zh: : 嗯……当然。没问题。

lines.en: : The um...chest area...might be a little tight, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那个……胸口那块……可能会有点紧。

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. They’re smaller than they look.
lines.zh: : 我没问题的。它们比看起来要小。

lines.en: : If...If you say so...
lines.zh: : 既……既然你这么说……

lines.en: scene black
I find myself standing around for several minutes, waiting to be called into Ami’s room to see the results of...coercion?
lines.zh: 我发现自己干站了好几分钟，等着被叫进 Ami 的房间去看……那场「软磨硬泡」的成果？

lines.en: The only other person I’ve seen win over Ami so quickly was Sara, and that’s probably just because she called her cute a bunch of times.
lines.zh: 我见过能这么快拿下 Ami 的人，除了她就是 Sara，而那大概只是因为 Sara 一个劲儿夸她可爱。

lines.en: I don’t want to jump the gun and say that Ami has {i}accepted{/i} Noriko yet, obviously...
lines.zh: 我显然不想操之过急地说 Ami 已经{i}接受{/i} Noriko 了……

lines.en: But this seems to be going a little too well.
lines.zh: 但这进展得似乎有点太顺利了。

lines.en: : Sensei! It’s safe to come in now!
lines.zh: : 老师！现在可以进来了！

lines.en: I open Ami’s door just seconds after being told it’s okay to come in.
lines.zh: 在被告知可以进来的几秒之后，我就推开了 Ami 的房门。

lines.en: And yes. I {i}was{/i} eagerly pacing back and forth in front of the door in anticipation.
lines.zh: {i}是{/i}的。我刚才确实满怀期待地在门前来回踱步。

lines.en: So far, every girl I have seen in the maid outfit has looked adorable.
lines.zh: 到目前为止，我见过穿那套女仆装的女孩，每一个都可爱极了。

lines.en: And even with Noriko’s hair as...meticulously disheveled as it is, I can’t imagine it will be any different for her.
lines.zh: 而即便 Noriko 的头发像现在这样……精心地乱着，我也想不出她会是个例外。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit23
: Good morning, Onii-chan! Sorry for taking so long, but it was suuuuuper hard trying to figure out how to put on this darned dress.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Onii-chan！抱歉让你等这么久，这破裙子穿起来实在太——难了。

lines.en: : Who are you and what have you done with Noriko?
lines.zh: : 你是谁，你把 Noriko 怎么了？

lines.en: : Sensei...why was she so insistent on calling you Onii-chan?
lines.zh: : 老师……她为什么非要叫你 Onii-chan？

lines.en: : Because Onii-chan is Onii-chan and I’m just the cute little girl next door!
lines.zh: : 因为 Onii-chan 就是 Onii-chan 嘛，而我只是隔壁那个可爱的小女孩！

lines.en: : You don’t have to try so hard with the persona. You're perfectly fine without it.
lines.zh: : 你不用这么卖力地演这个人设。你不演也很好。

lines.en: : Definitely much different than normal, but still perfectly fine.
lines.zh: : 确实跟平时很不一样，但依然很好。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit24
: Okay...that’s enough compliments for the day.
lines.zh: : 好啦……今天的夸奖到此为止。

lines.en: : It’s one thing letting her dress up in my clothes, but I’m not going to just let you stand there and ogle at her until the cows show up.
lines.zh: : 让她穿我的衣服是一回事，但我可不会让你站在这儿盯着她看到牛都出现。

lines.en: : It’s “until the cows come home,” Ami.
lines.zh: : 是「等到牛回家」，Ami。

lines.en: : You’re dumb. No cows have ever lived here. This is no home for them.
lines.zh: : 你真笨。这儿从来没住过牛。这儿才不是它们的家呢。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit25
: She is really cute, though.
lines.zh: : 不过她真的很可爱。

lines.en: : I like this look a lot more than her normal...outfit.
lines.zh: : 比起她平时的……那身打扮，我更喜欢这个样子。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit26
: Hm? Did I hear something about my normal outfit?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我好像听到有人在说我平时的打扮？

lines.en: : Do you want to try on my clothes, Ami? I think you’d look great.
lines.zh: : Ami，你想试试我的衣服吗？我觉得你穿一定很好看。

lines.en: : Oh. Umm...no thanks. You’re taller than me and...I’d want to take a shower first and stuff...
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……不用了。你比我高，而且……我想先洗个澡什么的……

lines.en: : Okay~ I think you'd make a cute little punk, though.
lines.zh: : 好吧～不过我觉得你会是个可爱的小朋克。

lines.en: : You should come out shopping with me sometime. I know a few spots at the mall that-
lines.zh: : 有空你该跟我一起去逛街。我知道商场里有几家店——

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit27
The doorbell suddenly rings and prompts everyone to stop dead in their tracks.
lines.zh: 门铃突然响了，所有人都当场僵住。

lines.en: It’s just a doorbell, so it may seem like an overreaction.
lines.zh: 只是个门铃而已，这反应看起来可能有点过度。

lines.en: But I’m pretty sure all of us are thinking the same thing.
lines.zh: 但我敢肯定，我们所有人想的都是同一件事。

lines.en: : Were you expecting anyone today, Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami，你今天有约人吗？

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit28
: I think it...
lines.zh: : 我觉得是……

lines.en: : I think it might be Maya...
lines.zh: : 我觉得可能是 Maya……

lines.en: : She mentioned something earlier about coming over, but I didn’t realize she meant like...{i}today{/i}.
lines.zh: : 她之前提过要过来，但我没想到她说的是……{i}今天{/i}。

lines.en: : So what do we do?
lines.zh: : 那我们怎么办？

lines.en: : Should I go out and distract her while Noriko gets dressed and...hides in the closet or something?
lines.zh: : 要不我出去拖住她，让 Noriko 穿好衣服……再躲进衣柜什么的？

lines.en: : No. Maya will obviously know something is going on if you go out to greet her.
lines.zh: : 不行。你出去迎接她，Maya 显然会察觉有情况。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit29
: It’s fine...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: : I mean, she already hates my guts, so it’s not like her opinion of me will get any worse.
lines.zh: : 我是说，她本来就恨死我了，所以她对我的看法也不会再差到哪儿去。

lines.en: : And I’m pretty sure she never expected me to listen to her about staying away from you.
lines.zh: : 而且我很确定，她从来就没指望我会听她的、离你远一点。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit30
: You...
: Chose me over her?
lines.zh: : 选了我而不是她？

lines.en: : I’ll...handle Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya 我……来处理。

lines.en: : Just...whatever you do, don’t come out of the room until you hear us leave.
lines.zh: : 只是……不管怎样，在我们离开之前，你们千万别出这个房间。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit31
: Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : I know. I don’t have to do this.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我并不非得这么做。

lines.en: : And, to be honest, I really don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 而且说实话，我真的不想。

lines.en: : But...this is what’s best for everyone.
lines.zh: : 可是……这对所有人都是最好的。

lines.en: : And I...think Noriko is really nice, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我……觉得 Noriko 人真的很好，所以……

lines.en: : Just hang out in here for a little while.
lines.zh: : 你们就在这里待一会儿吧。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit32
: But if you so much as {i}peep{/i} at her while she’s getting dressed, I will make sure both of you never live to see another day.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是敢在她换衣服的时候{i}偷看{/i}哪怕一眼，我保证你们两个都活不到明天。

lines.en: : Remind me to give you literally anything you want for the next...forever.
lines.zh: : 提醒我，接下来……直到永远，你要什么我都给。

lines.en: : What I {i}want{/i} is for Noriko to go home as soon as Maya and me are gone.
lines.zh: : 我{i}想{/i}要的是，等我和 Maya 一走，Noriko 就回家。

lines.en: : I might like her, but I still don’t want the two of you alone together.
lines.zh: : 我也许是喜欢她，但我还是不想让你们两个单独待在一起。

lines.en: : Okay, Mom.
lines.zh: : 好的，妈妈。

lines.en: : If you’re gonna be smart about it then-
lines.zh: : 你要是这么识相的话，那就——

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit33
: Ah, shoot! She must have used the spare key!
lines.zh: : 啊，糟糕！她一定是用备用钥匙进来的！

lines.en: : We have a spare key?
lines.zh: : 我们有备用钥匙？

lines.en: : Of course we have a spare key!
lines.zh: : 我们当然有备用钥匙！

lines.en: : Umm...guys?
lines.zh: : 呃……各位？

lines.en: : I know! I’m going! Keep quiet!
lines.zh: : 我知道！我去了！都别出声！

lines.en: scene black
scene norikofirstvisit34
: Hey, Maya! I didn’t realize you were coming over today.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Maya！我不知道你今天要来。

lines.en: : I texted you like four times and you didn’t respond to any of them.
lines.zh: : 我给你发了大概四条短信，你一条都没回。

lines.en: : Why are you touching me?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛碰我？

lines.en: : I’m just...really happy to see you.
lines.zh: : 我只是……见到你太高兴了。

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit35
: You’re weird.
lines.zh: : 你好奇怪。

lines.en: : Yeah. I guess I...am kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我想我……是有点奇怪。

lines.en: : No, like you’re acting weird.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说你现在表现得很奇怪。

lines.en: : What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 发生什么了？

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit36
: Is Sensei-
lines.zh: : 老师是不是——

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit37
: Taking a nap!
lines.zh: : 在睡午觉！

lines.en: : We got karaage on the way home and...his was raw and he’s...having stomach problems.
lines.zh: : 我们回家路上买了唐扬炸鸡，结果……他那份是生的，他现在……肚子不舒服。

lines.en: : And that’s...actually why I was about to leave.
lines.zh: : 所以……我其实正准备出门。

lines.en: : You’re not going to stay here and take care of him?
lines.zh: : 你不留下来照顾他吗？

lines.en: : I...need to go buy medicine!
lines.zh: : 我……得去买药！

lines.en: : I should have some in my bag if-
lines.zh: : 我包里应该有，如果——

lines.en: : He only likes medicine from brand new bottles!
lines.zh: : 他只喜欢从全新瓶子里倒出来的药！

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit38
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...
: So...how about the two of us go for a walk and then just...come right back.
lines.zh: : 那……不如我们两个出去走走，然后……马上就回来。

lines.en: : But my legs are so tired from-
lines.zh: : 可是我的腿好酸，因为——

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit39
: I’ll buy you something watermelon flavored~
lines.zh: : 我给你买西瓜味的东西～

lines.en: : My legs suddenly feel a lot better.
lines.zh: : 我的腿突然好多了。

lines.en: : Great! Then...let’s get going, shall we?
lines.zh: : 太好了！那……我们走吧？

lines.en: scene black
scene norikofirstvisit40
: Maya? What’s up?
lines.zh: : Maya？怎么了？

lines.en: : We’ve gotta get a move on before-
lines.zh: : 我们得赶紧走，不然——

lines.en: : Did you get new shoes?
lines.zh: : 你买新鞋了？

lines.en: : Um...y-yeah...
lines.zh: : 呃……是、是的……

lines.en: : Sensei just got them for me...but they’re a little too big.
lines.zh: : 是老师刚给我买的……不过有点太大了。

lines.en: : So we have to...take them back...
lines.zh: : 所以我们得……拿去退……

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit41
: Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit42
: They’re nice.
lines.zh: : 挺好看的。

lines.en: : Th-thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢、谢谢……

lines.en: : But I won’t be keeping them, so...
lines.zh: : 不过我不会留下它们的，所以……

lines.en: scene norikofirstvisit43
: Yeah.
: I wouldn't expect you to.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望你会留。

lines.en: : Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 走吧。

lines.en: : I’m hungry.
lines.zh: : 我饿了。

lines.en: : Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: scene black
